verdict.rationale: Codex officially supports MCP: it can act as an MCP client (add local/remote MCP servers via `codex mcp add`, shared config across CLI/IDE/desktop) and can be run as an MCP server for other clients to connect to (`codex mcp-server`). However, the server-side interface is explicitly labeled experimental and now deprecated in favor of an unspecified 'Codex app server', signaling instability for agent-to-agent integration via MCP.
